name: funk-files
description: Funk Files - Fast, safe PDF & file tools

scripts.captcha:seed: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const py = fs.existsSync('.venv/Scripts/python.exe') ? '.venv/Scripts/python.exe' : (fs.existsSync('.venv/bin/python') ? '.venv/bin/python' : 'python'); const p = spawn(py, ['seed_captcha_images.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); p.on('exit', code => process.exit(code || 0));"
